mission: SSC v1.0.1 EVIDENCE-FIRST FAILURE DECOMPOSITION V2

failure_hierarchy.evidence: gross_expectancy_R=-0.245, gross_PF=0.563, median_trade_R=-0.913, win_rate=36.4% (8W/13L/1BE). Gross is negative before friction, so the alpha deficit is primary.
confounders: small sample (N=22 < proposed economic-gate minimum of 30)

failure_hierarchy.evidence: stop_first_rate=50% (11/22). SL-resolved trades moved only mean_mfe_before_stop_R=0.324R favorably before the stop was hit -- adverse resolution followed almost immediately after entry.
failure_hierarchy.effect_size: 0.324R mean favorable excursion before stop; -1.0R gross each
confounders: cannot distinguish tight stop vs poor entry timing without a controlled experiment; N=11 is itself below the reportable threshold for a sub-analysis

failure_hierarchy.evidence: mean_partial_target_R=1.927 (reference-session boundary) vs mean_MFE_R=1.312 -- the first target is systematically beyond the typical favorable excursion, so partial_activation_rate=22.7% (5/22). Winners capture only mean_capture_efficiency_winners=52.3% of their MFE.
confounders: overlaps HYP_001_EXIT_CAPTURE territory (runner target), though the partial-target lever itself was not the HYP_001 treatment; N small

failure_hierarchy.evidence: LONDON_NEWYORK gross_expectancy_R=-0.551 (PF=0.13, 3W/7L, avg_win_R=+0.278) vs ASIAN_LONDON gross_expectancy_R=+0.010 (PF=1.02, 5W/6L/1BE, avg_win_R=+1.223). All S2 occurrences (2/2 stopped) landed in LONDON_NEWYORK.
confounders: N=10 is marginal; setup distribution differs (S2 only in LONDON_NEWYORK); not a causal session effect

failure_hierarchy.evidence: friction_R=4.92 total, mean 0.224R/trade, median 0.249R/trade, 47.7% of absolute net loss. Friction nearly doubles the per-trade loss but cannot explain the negative GROSS edge.
confounders: friction is a function of the stop distance and modeled spread/commission/slippage, not an independent failure

subgroup_guard.LONG: INSUFFICIENT_SUBGROUP_SAMPLE (N=4) -- 0/4 wins is descriptive only and does NOT independently justify a direction change
subgroup_guard.S2: INSUFFICIENT_SUBGROUP_SAMPLE (N=2) -- does NOT independently justify disabling S2
subgroup_guard.SHORT: REPORTABLE (N=18) -- gross_expectancy_R=-0.078, i.e. near-breakeven gross, NOT poor per-trade economics
subgroup_guard.direction_concentration_note: SHORT=18/LONG=4 mirrors the frozen H1 bias distribution (BEARISH=61 vs BULLISH=23 cycles); the bias gate only permits SHORT on BEARISH cycles and LONG on BULLISH cycles, so the concentration is a legitimate consequence of the market state, not a demonstrated direction-alignment defect.

regime_interaction.note: All 4 LONG occurrences (all stopped) occurred in RANGE; SHORT in RANGE is gross-breakeven. Regime x direction is confounded with the LONG N=4 subgroup.

HYP_001_EXIT_CAPTURE.collision_check: The observed EXIT_CAPTURE_WEAKNESS (partial-target reachability) is exit-capture territory but targets the PARTIAL target (reference boundary), NOT the RUNNER target that HYP_001 tested (runner_target_r 3.0R vs 1.5R). Classification if proposed: PARTIAL_OVERLAP -- NOT admissible as a clean duplicate; would require explicit governance justification.

HYP_002_SETUP_SELECTIVITY.status: VALIDATED_NEGATIVE / FALSIFIED (TREATMENT S1+S2 net=-0.356 vs CONTROL net=-0.408; both negative)
HYP_002_SETUP_SELECTIVITY.collision_check: S2 (N=2, gross=-1.0) is the worst setup but INSUFFICIENT_SUBGROUP_SAMPLE. Disabling any setup would be DUPLICATE_OF_HYP_002 and is NOT proposed.

hypothesis_admission.reason: No single mechanism has adequate sample support combined with an independently-testable STRUCTURAL change that is not numeric tuning. N=22 is below the proposed economic-gate minimum (30). The two most defensible signals -- (a) 50% stop-first with 0.32R pre-stop favorable excursion, and (b) partial target ~1.93R vs mean MFE ~1.31R -- would both imply numeric stop/target adjustments, which are explicitly excluded from hypothesis admission. The session gap (LONDON_NEWYORK vs ASIAN_LONDON) is N=10 and confounded by setup distribution.

falsification_rule: NOT_APPLICABLE (no hypothesis recommended; MECHANISM_FALSIFICATION vs ECONOMIC_GATE_PASS separation documented for a future hypothesis)

bounded_experiment.note: D16 requires D13 to justify a hypothesis first; D13 recommended none.
